Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and presence of bacteria and mucus further support this. Marked glucosuria is noted, which may suggest hyperglycemia/diabetes. Low specific gravity may indicate impaired urine concentration. No ketones or casts detected. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for diabetes and renal function are recommended.
